_readme: 样式聚合注册表（ADR-0022）：默认值与语义样式类的**唯一事实源** —— 渲染器（UiRegistries 消费方）与门禁（check-ui-yaml 两道）读同一份。 vocabulary 冻结纪律见 ADR-0022 §2/§3：defaults 只收"渲染器本该有默认而没默认"的槽位（Button/Toggle 的隐式样式口子刻意不进表）；styles 新增需实测配对 >= 3 次；本文件由 check-ui-yaml 全量扫描（无 CJK、token 引用必须存在）。

listRow.summary: Label + value row (P3 style aggregation, ADR-0022 s3): Grid(*,auto) two-text row, both center-aligned. Params feed the skeleton via whole-value placeholders; an omitted optional param drops that prop (falls back to node defaults). Admission rule (ADR-0022 s3, revised 2026-09-30): the FIRST preset only needs a motive + >= 1 real card measured (screen-time-list: 12 in-row props -> 4); from the 2nd preset on, cross-card reuse by >= 2 real cards.
